name: mx-lilac
description: The Lilac language of @motifx-community/design-system: the shared primitives, its scales, its light and dark themes and its densities. Same token names as the default language (mx.resolver.json), different values. Design Tokens Resolver Module 2025.10.

primitive.description: Shared palette and scales, the same in every design language.

identity.description: Lilac corner radii, elevation, type (Nunito Sans, Fraunces) and motion.

theme.description: Semantic colors and the focus ring, light and dark.

density.description: Control heights, paddings, gaps and the pressable feel.
